Hour 24 is valid only when it is exactly the end-of-day 24:00:00.000:

```js
const validHour =
  integerBetween(hour, 0, 23) ||
  (hour === 24 && minute === 0 && second === 0 && millisecond === 0);
```

So `hour === 24` is allowed iff `minute`, `second`, and `millisecond` are all strictly `=== 0` (not `undefined`/`"0"`). Anything else (e.g. `24:00:00.001`, `24:01`) fails with "unit out of range". `24:00` is then normalized to the next day's 00:00 by `objToLocalTS`/`Date.UTC`.
